images.author: chris clark
images.why: 4397 × 2473 original. Source identifies Loxodonta africana in Kenya’s savanna; isolated animal and natural grassland setting suit a poster crop.

images.author: Marek Bajbar
images.why: Source identifies Loxodonta africana. Standing elephant, grassy savanna and cloudy sky provide a classic habitat composition; original dimensions were not exposed.

images.author: Cyndi Perry/USFWS
images.why: 3859 × 2563 original explicitly captioned African savanna elephant in Pilanesberg National Park. Strong identification and unrestricted licence; the download timed out during verification.

images.author: Maysam Yabandeh
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies an adult male Loxodonta africana with large tusks in natural savanna. Linked preview is 1344 × 1012; page offers a 2953 × 2224 original.

images.author: Maysam Yabandeh
images.why: Explicit African bush elephant identification and natural shrubland setting; camera metadata supports photographic origin. Linked preview is 1344 × 1012; page offers a 4080 × 3072 original.

images.author: Maysam Yabandeh
images.why: Source identifies Loxodonta africana on savanna at sunset, offering warmer colour. Wide composition needs careful cropping; linked preview is 1344 × 756, with a 3347 × 1883 original offered.

images.author: Munib Chaudry
images.why: Caption confirms a fully grown African bush elephant bull photographed early morning in Amboseli. Excellent subject match; supplied 1024px size and watermark status could not be independently verified.

images.author: momathew
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies Umoja, a large male Loxodonta africana in Selenkay. Strong adult-bull alternative; supplied 1024px size and watermark status could not be independently verified.

images.author: Venkat Ragavan
images.why: Source explicitly identifies a wild adult Asian elephant in Bandipur forest, with Elephas maximus and tusks tags. Original download; green forest provides strong natural context.

images.author: Roshan Ravi
images.why: 5610 × 7480 original. Source identifies a tusked Asian elephant in Karnataka wildlife habitat; portrait orientation and lush vegetation are promising for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Sanket Mishra
images.why: 6960 × 4350 original, photographed with a Canon EOS 90D. Source identifies a tusked Indian elephant standing in jungle habitat; substantial resolution for cropping.

images.author: Rohit Varma
images.why: Source identifies an Indian elephant tusker on a riverbank. Prominent curved tusks, grassy foreground and water create a clear habitat portrait; linked image requests 3000px width.

images.author: Roshan Ravi
images.why: 6230 × 8306 original; source identifies a male Asian elephant at Bandipur National Park. Strong tusker portrait with green surroundings; closer framing compromises the full-body preference.

images.author: Sander Hoefnagels
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies a male Asian big tusker in Kabini, India. Distinctive crossed tusks make a striking alternative; monochrome treatment sacrifices colour, and pixel dimensions were not stated.

images.author: Rosa Gamboias
images.why: Caption explicitly confirms a wild Elephas maximus bull emerging from jungle in Jim Corbett National Park. Supplied 1024px size and watermark status could not be independently verified.

images.author: Fons Buts
images.why: Caption confirms a massive Asian elephant bull foraging at dawn in Kabini, Nagarhole National Park. Supplied 1024px size and watermark status could not be independently verified.
